## Why This Is Asked

Tests end-to-end asynchronous batch ingestion and real-time updates, with idempotency and tenant bounds, mirroring production concerns.

- Asynchronous processing and eventual consistency
- Idempotent endpoints and deduplication
- Streaming data integrity (order, duplicates)
- Fault injection and multi-tenant isolation

```javascript
// Python example demonstrates idempotent ingest test
async function testIdempotentIngest(client, payload, key) {
  const r1 = await client.post('/ingest', { json: payload, headers: { 'Idempotency-Key': key } })
  const r2 = await client.post('/ingest', { json: payload, headers: { 'Idempotency-Key': key } })
  assert r1.status === 200
  assert r2.status === 200
  assert r1.json().batchId === r2.json().batchId
}
```
